correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated 742 nonempty faces with f=(16,88,208,228,128,56,16,2), 367 acyclic pairs, critical 0-cell and seven 3-cells, and all 2816 Hasse covers. Independently evaluated oriented Lefschetz traces for all 384 affine cube automorphisms; each equals the displayed fixed-coordinate formula with character multiplicities {7:1,5:4,3:6,1:188,-1:161,-3:24}. Fourier orthogonality gives three trivial translation weights and the four distinct weight-three weights; the stabilizer sign identifies both irreducible modules. Exactly rational, not an asserted integral G-lattice decomposition.
